name: SPY-Confirmed TQQQ Trend Ladder
tagline: A SPY-confirmed QQQ trend ladder that uses 3x TQQQ only when the broad market is also above trend, with a vol target and a five-session drawdown brake.
summary: Hold TQQQ only when QQQ is above its 150-day SMA and SPY is above its 200-day SMA; hold QQQ when only QQQ is above trend, and BIL otherwise. The TQQQ sleeve is scaled to an 85% 20-day vol target and a -15% from-20-day-high brake forces five sessions in BIL. On the 2016-2023 development window it earned 50.36% CAGR / 43.27% DD / 1.20 Sharpe, with the lift coming mainly from stepping out of 2018-Q4 and 2022.
caveat: The literal 100-day/10% mandate centre fails at 20.64%, the delivered 150-day/15% cell is close to the old 165-day trend base, and the edge is concentrated in 2018-Q4 and 2022 crash avoidance, so it is dev-only until a holdout exists.
